lot_form_snapshot.view_definition_sql:
WITH cfg AS (
         SELECT COALESCE(( SELECT logic_variables.variable_value
                   FROM logic_variables
                  WHERE logic_variables.variable_key::text = 'semi_doubt_enabled'::text), 1::numeric) >= 1::numeric AS doubt_on,
            COALESCE(( SELECT logic_variables.variable_value
                   FROM logic_variables
                  WHERE logic_variables.variable_key::text = 'semi_doubt_max_link_parcels'::text), 3::numeric) AS max_link,
            COALESCE(( SELECT logic_variables.variable_value
                   FROM logic_variables
                  WHERE logic_variables.variable_key::text = 'semi_doubt_min_shared_len_m'::text), 5::numeric) AS min_len
        )
 SELECT p.id AS parcel_id,
        CASE
            WHEN f.link_parcels IS NOT NULL AND (f.link_parcels = 2 OR cfg.doubt_on AND f.link_parcels::numeric <= cfg.max_link AND f.best_shared_len_m >= cfg.min_len) THEN 'semi_half'::text
            ELSE 'detached'::text
        END AS lot_form_detected,
        CASE
            WHEN f.link_parcels IS NULL THEN 'o4_not_met'::text
            WHEN f.link_parcels = 2 THEN 'o4_two_parcel_abut'::text
            WHEN cfg.doubt_on AND f.link_parcels::numeric <= cfg.max_link AND f.best_shared_len_m >= cfg.min_len THEN 'doubt_multi_parcel_abut'::text
            ELSE 'o4_not_met'::text
        END AS lot_form_basis,
    f.link_parcels IS NOT NULL AND cfg.doubt_on AND (f.link_parcels = 2 AND f.best_shared_len_m < cfg.min_len OR cfg.doubt_on AND f.link_parcels > 2 AND f.link_parcels::numeric <= cfg.max_link AND f.best_shared_len_m >= cfg.min_len) AS unsure,
    f.link_parcels AS linked_parcel_count,
    f.best_shared_len_m
   FROM parcels p
     CROSS JOIN cfg
     LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT x.link_parcels,
            max(a.shared_len_m) AS best_shared_len_m
           FROM parcel_buildings pb
             CROSS JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT count(DISTINCT o.parcel_id)::integer AS link_parcels
                   FROM parcel_buildings o
                  WHERE o.building_id = pb.building_id AND o.is_primary) x
             JOIN parcel_buildings q ON q.building_id = pb.building_id AND q.is_primary AND q.parcel_id <> pb.parcel_id
             JOIN parcel_abutments a ON a.parcel_id = pb.parcel_id AND a.neighbour_id = q.parcel_id
          WHERE pb.parcel_id = p.id AND pb.is_primary AND x.link_parcels >= 2 AND x.link_parcels::numeric <= cfg.max_link
          GROUP BY x.link_parcels) f ON true;
